name: Fund Cash Forecast 7
definition: Cash movements from or to a fund as a result of investment funds transactions, eg, subscriptions or redemptions.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique technical identifier for an instance of a fund cash forecast within a fund cash forecast report as assigned by the issuer of the report.

TradeDateTime.name: Trade Date Time
TradeDateTime.definition: Date and, if required, the time, at which the price has been applied.

PreviousTradeDateTime.name: Previous Trade Date Time
PreviousTradeDateTime.definition: Previous date and time at which the price was applied.

FinancialInstrumentDetails.name: Financial Instrument Details
FinancialInstrumentDetails.definition: Investment fund class to which a cash flow is related.

TotalNAV.name: Total NAV
TotalNAV.definition: Total value of all the holdings, less the fund's liabilities, attributable to a specific investment fund class.

PreviousTotalNAV.name: Previous Total NAV
PreviousTotalNAV.definition: Previous value of all the holdings, less the fund's liabilities, attributable to a specific investment fund class.

TotalUnitsNumber.name: Total Units Number
TotalUnitsNumber.definition: Total number of investment fund class units that have been issued.

PreviousTotalUnitsNumber.name: Previous Total Units Number
PreviousTotalUnitsNumber.definition: Previous total number of investment fund class units that have been issued.

TotalNAVChangeRate.name: Total NAV Change Rate
TotalNAVChangeRate.definition: Rate of change of the net asset value.

InvestmentCurrency.name: Investment Currency
InvestmentCurrency.definition: Currency of the investment fund class.

CurrencyStatus.name: Currency Status
CurrencyStatus.definition: Information about the designation of the share class currency, that is, whether it is for onshore or offshore purposes and other information that may be required. This is typically only required for CNY funds.

ExceptionalNetCashFlowIndicator.name: Exceptional Net Cash Flow Indicator
ExceptionalNetCashFlowIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the net cash flow is exceptional.

Price.name: Price
Price.definition: Price per unit of the trade date.

PercentageOfShareClassTotalNAV.name: Percentage Of Share Class Total NAV
PercentageOfShareClassTotalNAV.definition: Net cash flow expressed as a percentage of the total NAV for the share class.

CashInForecastDetails.name: Cash In Forecast Details
CashInForecastDetails.definition: Cash movements into the fund as a result of transactions in shares in an investment fund, for example, subscriptions or switch-ins.

CashOutForecastDetails.name: Cash Out Forecast Details
CashOutForecastDetails.definition: Cash movements out of the fund as a result of transactions in shares in an investment fund, for example, redemptions or switch-outs.

NetCashForecastDetails.name: Net Cash Forecast Details
NetCashForecastDetails.definition: Net cash as a result of the cash-in and cash-out flows.

ExceptionalCashFlowIndicatorRule.definition: If Exceptional NetCashFlow Indicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then CashInForecastDetails/ExceptionalCashFlowIndicator and CashOutForecastDetails/ ExceptionalCashFlowIndicator must be present.
